source.author: stat
source.text: non hoc Argolidum coetu circumdata matrum speravi te, nate, sequi, nec talia demens fingebam votis annorum elementa tuorum, nil saevum reputans; etenim his in finibus aevi unde ego bella tibi Thebasque ignara timerem?
source.text_original: 'non hoc Argolidum coetu circumdata matrum / speravi te, nate, sequi, nec talia demens / fingebam votis annorum elementa tuorum, / nil saevum reputans; etenim his in finibus aevi / unde ego bella tibi Thebasque ignara timerem?
source.text_english: I did not hope, my son, when surrounded by that gathering of Argive mothers, to follow you thus, nor in my madness was I shaping such things for the years of your life in my prayers, deeming nothing cruel; for indeed in this borderland of life, where from should I, unknowing, fear wars and Thebes for you?

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ei mihi, Colchos unde ego et avecti timuissem vellera Phrixi?
reuse.text_original: ei mihi, Colchos / unde ego et avecti timuissem vellera Phrixi?
reuse.text_english: Alas for me, from Colchis, from where would I have feared the fleece of Phrixus, and borne it away?
